classification.difficultyReason: Use full-turn sums, including division among repeated equal unknown sectors.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the pronumeral.

spec.description: Undotted vertex, upward, leftward and lower-right rays. Upper-left square, right 136° arc and lower b arc.
spec.answerVisibility: b has no degree symbol and remains unknown.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}b+136+90 &= 360\\b+226 &= 360\\b &= 134\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two oblique lines cross at an undotted vertex. Circular angle outline and four individual c labels without degree symbols.
spec.answerVisibility: All four labels are c; no right-angle square is added.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}c+c+c+c &= 360\\4c &= 360\\c &= 90\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal and two diagonal lines meet at an undotted vertex, with a circular outline and six external d labels.
spec.mathematics: Six sectors labelled d partition a full turn. Source appearance is not to scale.
spec.answerVisibility: All six d labels retained without degree symbols.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+d+d+d+d+d &= 360\\6d &= 360\\d &= 60\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three left-facing rays at an undotted vertex. Upper-left e sector, lower-left 31° sector and large right-hand reflex 280° arc.
spec.answerVisibility: e remains symbolic without a degree symbol.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}e+31+280 &= 360\\e+311 &= 360\\e &= 49\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal straight line through an undotted vertex; upper semicircular f arc and lower semicircular 180° arc.
spec.answerVisibility: f has no degree symbol; retain the redundant 180° given.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}f+180 &= 360\\f &= 180\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Four plain-ended noncollinear rays meet at an undotted vertex. Circular arc sectors retain upper-left 64°, upper/right g, lower-right 76° and lower-left 82°.
spec.mathematics: User-approved reconstruction: sectors g, 64°, 82°, 76° counterclockwise from the right ray; g = 138°. The left and right rays are not a straight line.
spec.answerVisibility: g remains symbolic without a degree symbol; 138° appears only in answers.
spec.originalEvidence: The source image shows an apparently horizontal line inconsistent with the retained 82° and 76° sectors. The supplied inventory explicitly approves noncollinear reconstruction.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}g+64+82+76 &= 360\\g+222 &= 360\\g &= 138\end{align*}$$
